use IO.Std.write_line

struct BOUNDED is
    value: int

    init(value: int) is
        if value < 1 \/ value > 10 then
            throw System.Exception(
                "{value} is outside the range 1..10")
        fi

        self.value = value
    si

    +(other: BOUNDED) -> BOUNDED => BOUNDED(value + other.value)
    -(other: BOUNDED) -> BOUNDED => BOUNDED(value - other.value)
    *(other: BOUNDED) -> BOUNDED => BOUNDED(value * other.value)
    /(other: BOUNDED) -> BOUNDED => BOUNDED(value / other.value)

    <>(other: BOUNDED) -> int => value - other.value

    to_string() -> string => "{value}"
si

let a = BOUNDED(3)
let b = BOUNDED(4)

write_line("a = {a}, b = {b}")
write_line("a + b = {a + b}")
write_line("b - a = {b - a}")
write_line("a * a = {a * a}")
write_line("b / a = {b / a}")
write_line("a < b is {a < b}")
write_line("a >= b is {a >= b}")
write_line("a =~ BOUNDED(3) is {a =~ BOUNDED(3)}")

let attempts = [
    ("BOUNDED(11)", () => BOUNDED(11)),
    ("a - b", () => a - b),
    ("a * b", () => a * b)
]

for (text, attempt) in attempts do
    try
        write_line("{text} = {attempt()}")
    catch e: System.Exception
        write_line("{text} rejected: {e.message}")
    yrt
